title: Sum of Digits
statement:
Add up the digits of a whole number by peeling them off one at a time with a while loop.

The input is one integer `n` with `0 <= n <= 2000000000`. Print the sum of its decimal digits. The sum of the digits of 0 is 0. Work with the number itself, using remainder (`%`) and integer division, not by turning it into text.

Input:

```text
1234
```

Expected output:

```text
10
```
hints: `n % 10` gives you the last digit of `n`.
Dividing by 10 with integer division drops the last digit. Keep going while `n` is above 0.

python.solution:
def digit_sum(n: int) -> int:
    total = 0
    while n > 0:
        total += n % 10
        n //= 10
    return total


n = int(input())
print(digit_sum(n))
